name: Vinvest Capital Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要为年报、股东大会及因触发上市规则第8.03A条而发布的月度/其他公告。最新一季（截至2026年7月31日）营收同比增长174.7%至1122.6万令吉，但净利润为-64.4万令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins for its business segments; announcements were mainly annual reports, general meetings, and monthly/other announcements triggered by Paragraph/Rule 8.03A of the listing requirements. Latest quarter (ended 31 July 2026) revenue rose 174.7% year-on-year to MYR 11.226 million, while net profit was -MYR 0.644 million.
